_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your details. Run `node setup.js` to be guided interactively.

person._country_note: 2-letter country code. US (default), CA, GB, AU, etc. Non-US users: 'state' holds province/region; 'zip' holds postal code (any format, e.g. K1A 0A6 or SW1A 1AA); 'phoneFormatted' is the raw phone number with no US formatting.
person._state_note: For non-US: province or region (e.g. ON for Ontario, NSW for New South Wales)
person._zip_note: For non-US: postal code in your country's format (e.g. K1A 0A6, SW1A 1AA, 2000)
person._phone_note: For non-US: phoneFormatted equals phone with no reformatting applied

capsolver._comment: Sign up free at capsolver.com - pay-as-you-go, costs pennies/month for this use case

hibp._comment: Optional. Have I Been Pwned breach check (node watcher.js --breach-check). Get a key at https://haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key. Leave apiKey blank to disable.

accounts._comment: For sites that require a login. Leave password blank - setup.js will prompt you to create the account once, then store credentials here.

email._comment: Optional. Recommended: delete this whole block and handle email-only brokers by hand (they are logged as 'manual'). Brokers can see the SMTP account's own address (user), not just from, so only use a separate mailbox that is not linked to you, as both user and from. Never your everyday account. Gmail example for such a separate mailbox: host=smtp.gmail.com, port=587, an App Password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords); Gmail rewrites from to the account address.

relay._comment: Fork default: required. Without a working SimpleLogin relay (a real apiKey, not this placeholder) every person is blocked and the run exits non-zero with no submissions. One alias per person, shared by all brokers. See docs/relay.md.

generic._comment: Heuristic pass over ~490 sites from public datasets. Off in this fork. Set enabled to true (or pass --generic) to opt in; it uses your relay alias.

network._comment: Fork default: required. Before visiting any broker the browser must be on a Mullvad exit (am.i.mullvad.net). Using a different VPN or proxy? Set proxy (e.g. socks5://10.64.0.1:1080) and the check becomes 'browser IP differs from direct IP'. required: false disables the check (not recommended).
